title: Unit sale price declaration
plain: The price per gram, millilitre or piece is shown
plain_action: Look for a unit sale price beside the MRP, and confirm whether this is a single pack or a combination, group or multi-piece package.

citation.text: Screening paraphrase: declare the applicable unit price using the prescribed gram/kilogram, centimetre/metre, millilitre/litre or count basis, subject to the equal-price, State-excise and package-structure exceptions.

messages.pass: A unit price was located; its denominator and arithmetic are checked separately.
messages.violation: No required unit price was located for the confirmed ordinary single package.
messages.inconclusive: Confirm the applicable unit-price basis and exceptions.
